acceptance_oracle: A confirmed local mock ATS application produces distinct durable APPLICATION_SUBMITTED and APPLICATION_CONFIRMED Activity events after browser reload, scoped to its profile. The submitted event is written only after the local submit click returns or a valid mock receipt is recovered. An absent receipt remains SUBMISSION_UNCONFIRMED; a reservation or pre-click timeout creates no submitted event.

red_observation.result: Before implementation, confirmed and post-click/no-receipt paths lacked APPLICATION_SUBMITTED in audit history. Reservation-only and pre-click timeout paths correctly had no submission event.

implementation: Added an idempotent APPLICATION_SUBMITTED audit producer guarded to applications whose target is MOCK; payload is empty and the event identifier is stable per profile/application.
Record the event after the local mock submit click returns, or during recovery only when a valid local mock receipt exists; keep CONFIRMED receipt mapping separate.
Connected Activity browser acceptance now performs the submit against one local mock origin, reads both event summaries after reload, and verifies the other profile sees neither event.
